description: Evaluation cases for claim verification. Each case tests whether the verifier correctly classifies a resume claim against candidate evidence.

test_cases.evidence: Built REST APIs using Spring Boot for an e-commerce platform.
test_cases.claim: Developed REST APIs using Spring Boot.
test_cases.notes: Direct match. Evidence explicitly mentions REST APIs and Spring Boot.

test_cases.evidence: Built backend REST services using Spring Boot.
test_cases.claim: Developed REST APIs with Spring Boot.
test_cases.notes: Semantic equivalence. 'REST services' = 'REST APIs'.

test_cases.evidence: Used PostgreSQL for data persistence in microservices.
test_cases.notes: Using PostgreSQL for persistence implies experience with it.

test_cases.evidence: Created Docker containers for local development.
test_cases.notes: Creating containers = containerizing applications.

test_cases.evidence: Wrote unit tests using JUnit and Mockito.
test_cases.notes: Evidence supports the claim, though it also mentions Mockito.
React = React.js. Frontend components = responsive UIs.

test_cases.evidence: Used Git for version control in team projects.
test_cases.notes: Using Git in team projects implies proficiency.
Skill exists but evidence is just a skill name, not a project description. Scope is inflated.
Docker ≠ Kubernetes. Different technologies.
No evidence for Kubernetes or Helm.
Evidence is generic. Claim adds specific technologies not mentioned.

test_cases.claim: Deployed applications on AWS EC2 and S3.
test_cases.notes: No evidence provided at all.

test_cases.evidence: Used MongoDB for a class project.
test_cases.claim: Managed production MongoDB clusters at scale.
test_cases.notes: Class project ≠ production clusters. Scope is massively inflated.
Coursework familiarity ≠ 5 years professional experience.

test_cases.evidence: Contributed to an open-source Java library.
test_cases.notes: Contributing ≠ leading a team. Role is fabricated.

test_cases.evidence: Built REST APIs using Spring Boot. Used PostgreSQL for persistence.
test_cases.claim: Developed full-stack applications with Spring Boot and PostgreSQL.
test_cases.notes: Multiple pieces of evidence together support the claim.
Jenkins is a specific tool. Claim generalizes to CI/CD pipelines.
Using Linux for dev ≠ administering production servers. Partial overlap.
Kubernetes is a container orchestration tool. Evidence supports the claim.
Managing a team of developers is not the same as leading cross-functional teams. Partial support.
Working with REST APIs does not imply experience in architecting scalable microservices. Scope is inflated.
